utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need any tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could use a hammer, mine broke.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got a spare one. I'll bring it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? Are we sure we have the right parts for it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'm not sure. Did you check the model number?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No, I didn't think to check. I hope it's compatible.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, are we still doing that repair drive today? I thought it was next week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, really? I could've sworn it was today. Let me check my calendar again...

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I could've sworn it was next week. Let me double-check my calendar as well.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Ira, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? We're collecting broken items to fix them together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that sounds great! I have a broken toaster I've been meaning to get fixed. Where's it happening?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's at the community center, 10 AM to 4 PM this Saturday. They're fixing all sorts of small appliances and electronics.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Dane! I've got a list of folks who need help with small fixes. Let's start with Mrs. Gable's squeaky gate.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, I can grab my tools from the car. Where exactly is her gate?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Do we have a clear schedule for the repair drive? I like to know when things are happening.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I think it's been set for Saturday morning, but let me double-check with the organizers to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Saturday morning works for me. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What needs fixing on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I noticed a few cracks and some loose gravel. Want me to take a look?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, go ahead. What's the worst part?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, how's the repair drive coming along? I heard it's really bringing people together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's going well! I've seen a lot of folks pitching in with tools and materials.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great to hear! I'd love to lend a hand too—just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa! Are you getting ready for the repair drive this weekend? I was thinking we could team up for the tool check.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Mara! I was just about to start organizing the tool inventory. Let's meet Saturday morning at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll bring my checklist and we can go through everything together. See you Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Bo, I'm Cleo. I've been keeping an inventory of supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, hey Cleo. Repair drive? Sounds important. I'll try to drop by later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, we could use all the help we can get. I'll be at the community center sorting through parts if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey! Have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old bikes and appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I didn't know that. Where is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's at the community center parking lot, from 9 to 3 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did you say repair drive? I want to make sure I understand what you're referring to.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh yes! It's an event where we collect and fix broken toys and electronics from the school.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ah, I see. So we're gathering broken items from the school to fix them up. When does it start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, the repair drive. Hope it's going smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard it's been moving along, no major hiccups so far.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good to hear. Any idea when it'll be done?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, are you ready for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I've got my tools ready! Are you bringing that old lawnmower you mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I'm bringing the lawnmower. We're all set for Saturday morning, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, what day was that again? I think I missed the memo.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it's this Saturday, at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Great, I'll try to remember that. Is there anything specific I need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey, Gus. I heard about the repair drive. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, it's a community event where folks bring in broken items and we fix 'em together. I'm lending out my tools for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds helpful. I might have a couple of things to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal, thanks for coming by to talk about the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course, Rosa. I'm glad to help. What do you need me to keep track of for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great! I need you to keep a list of who's donating tools, what they're offering, and the times they're available to help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Did you check if the repair drive has a backup plan in case something goes wrong?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not sure, but I can ask Ava—she's the organizer.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a good idea—could you check with her soon? I'd feel better knowing there's a fallback.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure this repair drive is going to work? I've heard mixed things about those.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly have you heard? I want to make sure I'm not missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, I heard they can sometimes mess up the whole system if the voltage isn't just right. Has yours been checked?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Dane. I heard about the repair drive. Do you have a plan yet?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I haven't really planned much yet, but I'm happy to help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, we should start with a clear schedule. Do you know what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to fix up broken items folks bring in, like appliances or furniture. I've been keeping an inventory of donated parts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds really helpful. Do you need any extra hands or specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, that sounds important. What's it about again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a community event where we gather to fix up shared spaces and help neighbors with small repairs around their homes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, right! I think I have some old tools in the garage. Count me in for the next one.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, how can we fit the repair drive around the school pickups?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do the pickup tomorrow if you handle the drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, thanks Leo! I'll manage the drive.
